mentions.name: Active Web Technology Audit Crawler
mentions.description: A web-scale technology audit tool that crawls and classifies sites at 240 per second using a custom Python crawler, identifying the CMS, hosting, and technologies in use. It analyzes homepages with minimal probes and no headless browsers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An audit of the active web, what CMS, hosting and technologies are used.

Custom python crawler getting 240 sites a second crawled and classified. ( homepages and minimal probes, no headless browsers )
